mapper.sql: org_id = #{orgId} AND entity_type = 'organization' AND entity_id = #{orgId} AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(changes, '$.requestId')) AS UNSIGNED) = #{requestId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, org_id, action, changes, created_at FROM audit_log WHERE AND action = 'appi.subject_request.mission_purge.accepted' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(changes, '$.idempotencyKey')) = #{idempotencyKey} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT id, org_id, action, changes, created_at FROM audit_log WHERE AND action = 'appi.subject_request.mission_purge.accepted' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(changes, '$.operationId')) = #{operationId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT id, org_id, action, changes, created_at FROM audit_log WHERE AND action = 'appi.subject_request.mission_purge.completed' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(changes, '$.operationId')) = #{operationId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id, a.org_id, a.action, a.changes, a.created_at FROM audit_log a WHERE a.id > #{afterId} AND a.action = 'appi.subject_request.mission_purge.accepted' AND a.org_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_log c WHERE c.org_id = a.org_id AND c.entity_type = a.entity_type AND c.entity_id = a.entity_id AND c.action = 'appi.subject_request.mission_purge.completed' AND JSON_EXTRACT(c.changes, '$.operationId') = JSON_EXTRACT(a.changes, '$.operationId')) ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
